//: How the car arena is generated. Run it with: powershell -File tools/rebuild_level.ps1 -Level car_arena
notes: gen_car_arena.gd owns this level AND its challenge courses end to end, and overwrites
every byte of both. 'courses' reads the curves 'scaffold' saved, so it runs after it; it
writes no bake input (a course is a runtime overlay), so re-running it alone never
re-stales the bake. Hand edits to a course .tscn are lost on the next 'courses' run.
No props and no scatter, so there is no ground-hash stage and no resnap.

steps.why: Writes the island heightmap (plateau, lagoon, ridge) and splats (road paint, the ice bend, the apron), the six road curves, the LevelInfo and the level .tscn text.
The bake reads the terrain textures, so the fresh PNGs must be reimported first.
Packs the nine car course scenes from the saved curves.
